program.name: Three-Split 60 Tempo
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Three-Split 60's rhythm again, but Levels II and III slow every lowering to three seconds instead of adding reps.
program.about: The Three-Split 60 rhythm as a new program: chest and back, a full-body day, then abs and cardio. The full-body day alternates an upper and a lower focus, and abs finish every workout. The days and times match Three-Split 60, but it is built fresh, so the exercises are not the same ones. Where Three-Split 60 adds reps, this one gets harder by slowing down: at Levels II and III every lowering takes three seconds, on every move that can be slowed. Holds such as planks stay as they are. Suits you if you like the three-day rhythm and want more from each rep.
program.split: Chest & back / full body / abs & cardio
